title: TaskFuel — paid tools for your AI, one balance
excerpt: Let your AI search, research and run specialist tools from one prepaid balance. No separate provider accounts or subscriptions. Start with $5 free.
content_html:
Give your AI access to paid tools when the task needs them. One balance, no separate accounts, no subscriptions.

No card required

Search by what
your agent needs.

Ask once. Get the paid tool and the result.

Connect TaskFuel once. Your agent can find a suitable paid tool, show the provider and price, and bring the result back.

01

Tell your agent what you need

Describe the useful result. No provider shopping trip first.

02

It finds a suitable paid tool

The provider and price stay visible before money leaves your balance.

03

You get the result and receipt

The delivered output, provider and cost come back together.

Good questions.

How does my AI use TaskFuel?

Connect TaskFuel once, then ask for the result you need. Your AI can search the available paid tools, show the price and return the result in the same conversation.

Do I need an account with every provider?

No. You need one TaskFuel account and one prepaid balance for the paid tools currently available through TaskFuel.

Is TaskFuel a subscription?

No. Successful uses come from your prepaid balance. You can add more by card when you need it; TaskFuel does not charge a monthly subscription.

When do I see the price?

Before payment. The provider and exact price for that request stay visible alongside the result.

What happens if a tool fails?

A failed result does not debit your TaskFuel balance.

What can it do today?

The current catalog covers live web and social search, company and people enrichment, market data, AI inference, chain data and short-lived compute. Search above for the task you have in mind.

Offer a useful paid tool?

Tell us what it helps people do and what each successful use costs. Every submission is reviewed before it appears in TaskFuel.

Reviewed by a person

Outcome
A clear useful result

Price
Visible per successful use

Quality
Reviewed before listing

PROVIDER INTEREST

Tell us what you run.

We review what the tool does, what it costs and whether the result is reliable. Listing is not automatic.

One account. $5 to try it.

No card required. Add more only when you need it.

Start with $5 free

How does my AI use TaskFuel?

Do I need an account with every provider?

不需要。您需要一个 TaskFuel 帐户和一笔预付余额，用于当前通过 TaskFuel 提供的付费工具。

Is TaskFuel a subscription?

不会。成功的使用来自于您的预付余额。 您可以在需要时通过卡添加更多； TaskFuel 不收取每月订阅费用。

When do I see the price?

付款前。 该请求的提供商和确切价格与结果一起可见。

What happens if a tool fails?

失败的结果不会扣除您的 TaskFuel 余额。
